comment: Source of truth for Prometheus MCP service connectivity. HTTP services have port+path. stdio services have command+args.

surreal-memory.description: Surreal-memory distributed knowledge graph, scoped memory, TaskStreams, Graph-RAG

prometheus-knowledge.description: pk-cherry HTTP MCP — Karpathy LLM Knowledge Base (knowledge_ingest, knowledge_focus, knowledge_search)

forge-rs.description: Forge code-enrichment engine (forge_enrich, forge_reflect, forge_drift, forge_validate)

sycophancy-correction.description: Sycophancy detection and correction (detect_sycophancy, correct_sycophancy, analyze_reflect_phase)

liter-llm.description: Multi-model routing proxy — MCP tools across 140+ providers. --config is REQUIRED: liter-llm's ProxyConfig::discover() walks the CWD upward and never searches $HOME, so without it the server starts with ZERO models.

sequential-thinking.description: Sequential thinking MCP for structured step-by-step reasoning

tavily.description: Tavily web search MCP (tavily_search, tavily_extract, tavily_research) — search-first, ranked result aggregation

firecrawl.description: Firecrawl web data pipeline MCP — 13 tools: scrape, crawl, map, extract, search, interact. Uses hosted api.firecrawl.dev (key from FIRECRAWL_API_KEY env). Extraction-first; use for full page content, PDFs, dynamic UIs. Use tavily for search-first discovery.
